items.english: Before long the two came out wrapped in the rising steam, already talking together with easy openness. Among spa people, quick to be friendly, Tatsuya was quickest at such things. As they parted for their rooms, master Hotei left this word behind, "Do come round a little to amuse me. I am at a loss with dullness." "To my side too, by all means," Tatsuya answered without lagging in courtesy, bending lightly at the waist.

Thus Tatsuya learned that Hotei was Miyoshi Zenpei by name, and in passing that his daughter was Mitsuyo, the youngest child and his treasured one. Miyoshi was a man of wealth he had heard tell of. Good. Very good indeed. For the days ahead to be idly spent, one more solace for the heart is one to the good. Beautiful prey. Puffing his cigar at ease, he thought after a while, and is not the rich man a fine thing too. Let this moment not be lost. He smiled to himself and breathed out smoke again.
notes: Kept 美しき獲物 as beautiful prey to hold the sporting appetite of the passage; left the Good, Very good reckoning as free thought without quotes so his tone does not darken, and kept cigar and smoke wording steady for the calculation motif.

items.english: Clouds over the peaks flew chasing one another. Pines and far mountains were lost to sight. Rain coming. The voices of birds grew ever shriller.

data.say: Drafted the bath parting, Tatsuya's untroubled counting of daughter and father, and the weather break into part two.
